Job Title: AI Engineer
Location: Chennai
Job description
We are looking for an energetic, smart, and passionate AI professional who is excited about building the next generation of enterprise conversational AI. If you enjoy solving complex problems, working with cutting-edge AI technologies, and building production-grade agent systems, we d love to hear from you.
Role Description
InteliSense is an enterprise AI contact center platform (voice + chat) spanning two independent deployment stacks an Azure/LangGraph stack and an AWS stack (Amazon Connect + Bedrock AgentCore).
Responsibilities
Own Agent design and Orchestration
Build new self-service and specialized agent
Wire up Tool/MCP Integrations
Design and Build HITL flows for Production Voice / Chat
Must-Have Technical Skills
Strong hands-on experience with LangGraph or comparable agent orchestration frameworks.
Strong hands-on experience with Azure AI Search (or equivalent Elasticsearch / OpenSearch / Pinecone / Weaviate) including hybrid search and reranking.
Experience with embedding models, chunking strategies, and index design for RAG at production scale.
Experience with LLM API Integration.
Solid Python and Fast API experience.
Experience designing multi-agent systems- supervisor/specialist patterns, tool-calling agents, agent-to-agent handoff
Familiarity with MCP, building or consuming MCP servers as agent tools
Experience with Redis for session/state persistence
Understanding of HITL design patterns for production conversational AI (escalation, confirmation gates, failure routing)
Understanding of multi-tenant SaaS architecture.
Comfortable working with REST/Graph APIs as agent tools
Nice-to-have Skills
Experience with Amazon connect and Bedrock AgentCore.
Experience with Azure OpenAI or other LLM APIs in a production Agent context.
Familiarity with LangSmith or other LLM Observability/eval tooling.
Experience with Voice channel agent design.
Background in contact center /ITSM domains.
Exposure to Prompt Engineering for structured agent behaviour.
Experienced in MongoDB for document/session storage.
Exposure to Azure Functions or serverless ingestion pipelines.
Experienced with Voice AI Pipelines.
Experienced in Information Retrieval or NLP Search.
